description: This file contains mock data generators and constants for a food delivery admin dashboard, including icons, interface imports, and functions to generate dummy data for restaurants, riders, orders, users, banners, zones, coupons, cuisines, notifications, withdraw requests, dispatch orders, foods, staff, and vendor store details.

methods.name: generateRandomUserCounts
methods.description: Generates an array of 12 unique random integers between 0 and 100.
